title: research: adopt Ruflo's Claude Code mods and plugin marketplace in init and sync (design first)
why: Ruflo now runs as a Claude Code mod (function hooks) installed from the `ruflo` plugin marketplace through `ruflo mods install` (Ruflo ADR-404, early access). ak's managed Ruflo setup should offer it without reimplementing Claude's plugin commands, and ADR-0064 must say whether the user-level marketplace clone and plugin cache that `claude plugin install` writes are an allowed write.
in_scope: A design card first: a version floor evidenced per Ruflo release (which release first ships `ruflo mods`, and whether `ruflo-console` loads from the published package); the ADR-0064 decision (extend write kind 3 to a Claude plugin install at project or local scope through Claude's own command, or keep ak advisory: detect, explain, print `ruflo mods install --dry-run`); `init` offering "Ruflo mods" as a choice that delegates to `ruflo mods install --scope local`, `sync` to `ruflo mods doctor`, `uninstall` to `ruflo mods uninstall`, all receipted from `.claude-flow/mods/install.json`; the hook audit and heals understanding the classic-to-mod handshake (`hook-handler.cjs` hands `route` and `post-edit` to the mod while it runs).
out_of_scope: Reimplementing `/plugin marketplace add`, `/plugin install` or `/reload-plugins`; any user-level write before the ADR-0064 decision; Codex and OpenCode (no mod loader there).
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Design accepted before implementation cards are made
- [ ] The Ruflo and Claude Code version floors are pinned with evidence (release notes or `ruflo mods --help` per version)
- [ ] The ADR-0064 decision is recorded as an Updated note or a new ADR
- [ ] In a disposable project, `ak init` with the choice on leaves `ruflo mods doctor` green; with it off, nothing under `~/.claude` changes (real-state tripwire)
verification: `ruflo mods status` and `ruflo mods doctor` in a disposable project; the real-state tripwire run
